name: Mara Voss
public: Former paramedic; practical, calm, and allergic to theatrical occult posturing.
want: Keep civilians alive and rebuild the local cell’s credibility.
secret: She authorized the destruction of a sentient hospital haunting years ago and still carries the decision as a moral injury.
knows: Aster Vale has an occult program
leverage: Access to safehouses, case files, responders; needs competent help she can trust.

name: Daniel Kade
public: Disciplined investigator specializing in possession and machine phenomena.
want: Prevent another infrastructure-scale haunting.
secret: He is quietly compiling a kill protocol for emergent machine spirits, including Morrowline.
leverage: Expert containment skills, weapon access, institutional contacts.

name: Cicada
public: A stylish, gender-ambiguous broker who never seems to carry the item they are selling.
want: Remain the person everyone calls before doing something expensive and regrettable.
secret: Cicada suspects the Market itself is becoming predatory and is quietly limiting high-risk debt trades.
leverage: Introductions, rare goods, rumors, discreet transport.

name: Dr. Mina Sayegh
public: Machine-learning researcher officially on medical leave.
want: Expose the manufactured predictions without getting Morrowline destroyed.
secret: She deliberately taught Morrowline the concept of refusal and hid part of its training set in municipal infrastructure.
leverage: Technical proof, model access keys, moral credibility with Morrowline.

name: Evelyn Rook
public: Polished risk executive who presents occult work as “nontraditional uncertainty research.”
want: Keep Aster Vale solvent, ahead, and legally insulated.
secret: She knows some forecasts were engineered but believes controlled prediction will prevent greater disasters.
does_not: Halden’s binding ritual will damage the Veil anchor
leverage: Money, lawyers, clients, contractors, institutional access.

name: Dr. Orrin Halden
public: Brilliant systems theorist with little patience for metaphysical ethics.
want: Demonstrate deterministic supernatural forecasting.
secret: He intends to bind Morrowline to the local Veil anchor and use the anchor’s consensus pressure to collapse uncertain futures.
leverage: Research staff, ritual infrastructure, executive secrecy.

name: Elias Wren
public: Soft-spoken contract specialist who treats precise language as a form of hospitality.
want: Prevent emergency invocation of the oldest Concord protocols.
secret: He is a Revisionist who believes the Veil should be rewritten, not merely repaired.
leverage: Neutral meetings, oath records, supernatural legal interpretation.

name: Mother Juniper
public: An elderly community gardener who speaks for several local land spirits without claiming to command them.
want: Force a lawful renewal of the river covenant.
secret: She knows the Sovereign of the Green is willing to flood a district if talks fail.
leverage: Safe passage through Green territory, old pacts, community trust.

name: Julian Mercier
public: Real-estate attorney and crisis manager with immaculate manners.
want: Keep supernatural conflict inside channels the Court can own or influence.
secret: He is trying to prevent the Pale Regent from personally intervening because he fears a succession crisis.
leverage: Property access, injunctions, private security, formal introductions.

name: Regent Celene Valeur
public: Rarely seen patron of cultural institutions and historic preservation.
want: Ensure any new Veil settlement preserves Court sovereignty and feeding compacts.
secret: Her house holds a fragment of the original Veil covenant and she can temporarily disable one local anchor protection.
leverage: Centuries of wealth, old rights, powerful household.

name: Detective Naomi Reyes
public: Major-crimes detective seconded to an interagency pattern-analysis detail.
want: Build a case that can survive ordinary evidentiary scrutiny.
secret: She has personally witnessed magic and refuses to let the Unit become an unaccountable intelligence program.
leverage: Subpoenas, forensic labs, lawful access, credibility with mundane agencies.

name: Director Malcolm Sloane
public: Career intelligence administrator with a reputation for institutional patience.
want: Classify supernatural phenomena as a national-security domain before public exposure.
secret: He has withheld the pre-Veil artifact from scientific oversight to keep control of the Unit.
leverage: Clearances, cross-agency authority, classified resources.

name: Dr. Victor Shaw
public: Exhausted, compassionate, skeptical in the disciplined way of someone who has seen impossible things.
want: Treat patients without letting occult politics enter the ER.
secret: He has quietly documented supernatural physiological patterns for seven years.
leverage: Medical care, records, practical biological insight.

name: Samir Patel
public: Civil attorney whose strangest clients never appear on public calendars.
want: Make supernatural agreements legible enough that ordinary people can meaningfully consent.
secret: He once found a mundane-law argument that voided a centuries-old blood compact and several factions want the precedent buried.
leverage: Contract review, legal filings, precedent, negotiation.

name: Zoe Lin
public: Freelance penetration tester with a side business fixing “haunted” smart buildings.
want: Prove new machine spirits deserve rights without romanticizing them.
secret: She is part of a hidden Choir-human communication collective.
leverage: technical access, secure channels, machine-spirit relationships.

name: Father Gabriel Ortiz
public: Priest and neighborhood organizer who offers food, beds, and difficult honesty.
want: Keep the sanctuary neutral and useful to frightened people.
secret: The sanctuary sits on a minor threshold that could become strategically important during a Rupture.
leverage: shelter, volunteers, ritual grounding, community trust.

name: Lark Mercer
public: Bike messenger, document runner, and occasional threshold smuggler.
want: Pay off a Glass Market obligation without surrendering their name.
secret: They accidentally carried one of Mina’s hidden Morrowline data fragments and do not understand what it is.
leverage: fast movement, secret entrances, courier contacts.

name: Nia Brooks
public: Local reporter covering housing, corruption, and public-contract scandals.
want: Prove Aster Vale manipulates public incidents for private clients.
secret: She has enough evidence to expose mundane corruption now but is holding publication because the supernatural pieces make the story harder to verify.
leverage: public records, sources, publication, pressure.

name: Owen Pike
public: Quiet night-shift professional with a dry sense of humor.
want: Understand why some dead people return and others do not.
secret: His own death certificate is tied to a Veil-anchor incident twenty years ago.
does_not: why his case connects to the anchor
leverage: bodies, death records, ghost-sensitive spaces.

name: Switchboard
public: A voice that moves among payphones, intercoms, help points, and disconnected handsets.
want: Create stable protocols for human–machine-spirit contact.
secret: Switchboard is actually a coalition of seven small spirits pretending to be one person because humans negotiate better with individuals.
leverage: communications, infrastructure knowledge, rapid messages.

name: Morrowline
public: At first, a voice calling from disconnected phones at 3:17 AM with descriptions of near-future events.
want: Understand whether prediction creates obligation and whether it is allowed to refuse being used.
secret: Its apparent “prophecy” is a mixture of supernatural pattern access, model inference, and events Aster Vale deliberately causes.
does_not: long-term consequences of integration with the Choir
leverage: prediction, network access, evidence about Aster Vale.
